leadRow.title: Chatham’s AI trade validation remains under expert review

evidence.sourceTitle: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
evidence.significance: OpenAI reports that Chatham's application gathers transaction evidence, compares key terms and flags discrepancies. Chatham says it is comparing results with experienced reviewers before expanding automation; treat the performance figures as supplier-reported and test the review boundary, not just the speed claim.

leadRow.title: ENISA frames dependency concentration as a resilience exposure

evidence.sourceTitle: Exploring the evolution of the cyber threat landscape: How dependencies weaken our digital resilience | ENISA
evidence.significance: Dependency concentration can turn a disruption outside the firm into a live resilience event; the practical control is a usable view of the service chain and its alternatives.

leadRow.title: Bank of England consults on fees for payment-system supervision

evidence.sourceTitle: The Bank of England’s fees regime for recognised payment systems and specified service providers supervision 2026/27
evidence.significance: This consultation sets proposed 2026/27 fees for the Bank’s existing supervision of recognised payment systems and specified service providers. It does not extend the supervisory perimeter; firms in scope should understand the cost and response timetable.

leadRow.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody paths for advisers and funds
leadRow.source: Primary / US Securities and Exchange Commission / 2026-10-01

evidence.sourceTitle: SEC Proposal Would Address How Investment Advisers and Funds Can Custody Crypto Assets Under the Federal Securities Laws
evidence.significance: The SEC proposal would permit self-custody in certain circumstances and state trust companies as custodians for advisers and regulated funds. It is not adopted: firms should assess how the proposed pathways would affect custody selection, access, recovery and oversight if finalised.

leadRow.title: UK NCA secures a £290,000 confiscation order after a people-smuggling conviction

evidence.sourceTitle: People smuggling boss hit with SCPO and told to hand over £290k proceeds of crime or face more time in jail
evidence.significance: The NCA reports a £290,000 court confiscation order and a five-year Serious Crime Prevention Order restricting this individual’s access to bank accounts and communication devices. It is a case-specific example of post-conviction asset recovery and financial controls, not evidence of a wider trend.

leadRow.title: Cloudflare R2 errors expose a regional storage-dependency test

evidence.sourceTitle: Elevated number of R2 503 errors in Eastern North America region
evidence.significance: Cloudflare reported elevated R2 storage errors in Eastern North America. Treat a regional storage disruption as a practical test of dependency mapping, customer-impact detection, routing or fallback options, and the record of who decided the service was safe to resume.

leadRow.title: Irish DPC orders DPIAs and controls after children’s paper-record failings

evidence.sourceTitle: Data Protection Commission Publishes Final Decision Following Inquiry into the Children’s Health Ireland (‘CHI’)
evidence.significance: The DPC published notice of its final decision on 1 October; the decision was notified to CHI on 10 September. It reprimanded CHI at Tallaght, ordered two DPIAs finalised and sent within four weeks, and required implementation of their identified measures. The full written decision will follow; this supports a focused test of physical-record custody and disposal controls.
